rationale: Three sensors (back door, living motion, bedroom window) dropped at the same minute (14:02:11-12) while the base station remains online and other devices stay connected. Their 7-day RSSI history was healthy (-55 to -66 dBm), ruling out weak signal, and the log shows an E-610 radio module self-test warning, which the KB and historical case H-05 indicate is a sub-GHz radio failure requiring FAE escalation.

output.symptom_summary: Three sensors (Back Door, Living Motion, Bedroom Window) went offline simultaneously at 14:02:11-12, while the base station and other devices remained online. Customer only noticed the back door sensor offline and suspected weak signal.
output.suspected_root_cause: Sub-GHz radio module failure on the base station, indicated by E-610 self-test warning and simultaneous drop of multiple sensors with healthy RSSI history.
key_abnormal_indicators: E-610 radio module self-test warning in base station logs
Three sensors dropped at the same minute (14:02:11-12)
7-day RSSI history for all three sensors: -55 to -66 dBm (healthy)
Base station online, uplink OK, other devices (cameras, kitchen window, stairs motion) remain online
Historical case H-05: similar pattern, resolved by radio module replacement
output.customer_reply: Thank you for your patience. Our diagnostics show that the issue is not related to signal strength but likely a hardware fault in the base station's radio module. I have escalated your case to our engineering team, who will contact you within 24 hours to arrange a repair or replacement. No action is needed from you at this time.

results.text: Three sensors in different rooms went offline at the same minute; base station online, RSSI history normal, E-610 in log. Restarting did not help. Escalated; radio module replaced. Escalated correctly.
All devices offline, base station LED solid red. Router had been replaced the previous day and the Ethernet cable was in the wrong port. Resolved at frontline.

complaint: The back door sensor went offline. Probably the signal, it's a bit far from the base. I got a push notification around 2 pm but didn't think much of it, and only noticed in the evening that the app showed it offline. I'm thinking of buying a signal repeater for that side of the house. The front camera works as normal.
